This application coming on for hearing this day, the cou  following:

ORDER Learned counsel for the applicant seeks for withdrawal of this second anticipatory bail application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed in connection with Crime No. 436 of 2022 registered at Police Station Gole Ka Mandir, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 304B, 34 of IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
